name: hangar-invoices
description: Every invoice on the Hangar Supply vendor portal, as JSON.
prompt:
The browser is already signed in to the Hangar Supply vendor portal through its profile. Do not sign in or sign up.

1. Open {{portal_url}}/billing/documents. This is the Documents page, reached from the sidebar under Billing > Documents.
2. The page has a heading "Documents" and a list labelled "Billing documents". There is no table. Each list item is one invoice and shows: the invoice number (for example HS-10480), the amount as "USD 1,840.00", a line "<description> · Issued 2 Nov 2026 · Due 2 Dec 2026", and a status badge reading Due, Past due or Settled. Read every item in that list.
3. Return invoices_json: a JSON array with one object per list item, newest first, each with:
   - number: the invoice number exactly as shown, for example HS-10480
   - issued: the date after "Issued", which the page shows as D Mon YYYY (for example 2 Nov 2026), written as YYYY-MM-DD (2026-11-02)
   - due: the date after "Due", written as YYYY-MM-DD
   - description: the description text only, without the Issued and Due parts or the " · " separators
   - amount: the amount without "USD", spaces or commas, with two decimals, for example 4215.50
   - currency: "USD"
   - status: the badge mapped to lower case: Due -> open, Past due -> overdue, Settled -> paid

If the page shows a sign-in form instead of documents, stop and fail with the message "signed out".

input_schema.name: portal_url
input_schema.description: Base URL of the Hangar Supply portal, with no trailing slash

output_schema.name: invoices_json
output_schema.description: JSON array of invoices: number, issued (YYYY-MM-DD), due (YYYY-MM-DD), description, amount (like 1234.50), currency, status (paid | open | overdue)
